title: fix(service-analytics, lint)!: a dataset or cube dimension over a formula field is refused where it is authored, instead of on the first query that groups by it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1W98tqSQjC4jC6VTdbuasE)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytQjG9X1CrCgytUM5

Fixes #30773

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` names `dimension-virtual-field-refused` beside `dimension-json-stored-field-refused` and in its cube paragraph (seat-approved surface addendum); follow-up #30824 — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`'s formula row (Tier H, the skills lane).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集（或 cube）的维度如果指向公式字段（不落库的虚拟字段），现在在"写的时候"就被拒：数据集编译（`registerDataset` / `queryDataset`）给 `DATASET_INVALID` / 400，点名数据集、维度、位置和修法；`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 与运行时保存数据集（Studio、REST `/meta`、MCP 共用的那道门）报新规则 `dimension-virtual-field-refused`。
- 为什么改：#29304 之后，按公式字段分组的查询在所有分析入口都会 400，但数据集本身照样能保存、发布，错误要等看板读者打开图表才出现。度量侧（对公式字段求和）早已在编译和 lint 两处拒绝，维度侧缺这一半。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄"维度指向公式字段"这一种写法；含这种维度的整个数据集将无法编译，连它的其它存储字段维度也不再出数（这是收窄的代价，changeset 的 BREAKING 段写明）。存储字段维度、日期维度和所有度量判定不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts` 的 `assertDimensionFieldStored`；`packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` 的 `virtualDimensionFinding` 及数据集、cube 两腿的调用点；`preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts` 里公式维度从共享数据集拆出（原 #29167 / #29304 的数据集面钉现在钉编译期拒绝）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/aggregate-nontemporal-measure-refusal.test.ts`，预期全部通过，含 6 条 `[#30773]` 用例。
- 需要你做的：无；契约复核后席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/service-analytics`: the compile refuses the dimension.**
- `compileDataset`'s dimension loop now calls `assertDimensionFieldStored` after `assertDeclared`, the way the measure loop calls its type gate after the join check. A dimension whose `field` the base object declares VIRTUAL, judged by the spec's `isVirtualSearchField` (`SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`, today `formula`), whatever its `returnType` and with or without `dateGranularity`, throws `datasetInvalidError` (`DATASET_INVALID` / 400). The message names the dataset, the dimension, its position (`dimensions.N`), the field and its declared type, and the remedy the query-time doors name: denormalise the value onto the object (a stored field, written when the source changes) and point the dimension at that field.
- It reaches every door the measure refusal (#24426) reaches, because both run inside `compileDataset` through the service's one `compile()`: `registerDataset` (the configuration door), `queryDataset` on every face (native, ObjectQL, the draft preview), and the build probes that query through it.
- Tiering is the measure gate's ("cannot answer, do not block"): no `declaredValueShape` hook, a field the hook does not resolve, or a dotted relationship path (the hook answers for the base object only) is not judged here. A dotted dimension over a joined formula stays the query-time doors' (#29304) and the lint leg's.

**`@objectstack/lint`: `dimension-virtual-field-refused`.**
- A new id beside `dimension-json-stored-field-refused` in `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts`, so it rides the one registry entry: gating, on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, and at the runtime `dataset` write door (`422`). One verdict for a dataset dimension (`datasets[N].dimensions[M].field`) and an authored cube dimension (`analyticsCubes[N].dimensions.KEY.sql`), resolved on the object graph exactly as the JSON-stored leg resolves it, dotted paths included (judged on the leaf's object), with the same skips. The predicate is the spec's `isVirtualSearchField`, never a local list. A formula is never JSON-stored, so the two dimension ids never fire on one member.
- One-line verdict and fix, as the #22161 siblings. Verdict: groups by field "FIELD" (formula on object "OBJECT"), a value computed on read and never stored, so no query can group by it. Fix: Store the value in a stored field of "OBJECT" (written when its source changes) and point this dimension at that field, or remove the dimension. The reasoning (which doors refuse it, why a computed value is no group key) is `os explain dimension-virtual-field-refused` (`rule-explanations.ts`). The id's constant is exported from the package barrel beside its two siblings.

**Measured before the change** (on `origin/main` `2d04cd2b`, probes since deleted):
- (a) A dataset dimension over a `formula`: `registerDataset` ACCEPTED; `queryDataset` selecting a stored dimension of it SERVED (1 statement); selecting the formula dimension refused only at query time.
- (b) A cube dimension whose `sql` names a formula column: no authoring door judged it (cubes are registered without a compile; the query-time door refuses it since #29304).
- (c) `runAuthoringRules` on validate / build / lint: zero findings for either (the only finding on the probe stack was an unrelated `expression-invalid` on the probe's own formula, fixed in the probe).

## Tests

- `service-analytics` `aggregate-nontemporal-measure-refusal.test.ts` (the #24426 harness), new top-level describe `[#30773]`: the request door refuses `DATASET_INVALID` / 400 with the exact message and no SQL emitted, for a selection naming the formula dimension and for one naming only the stored dimension; the configuration door (`registerDataset`) refuses in the same words; a date dimension bucketed by month over a formula is refused at its position; controls (a stored, a date-bucketed and a numeric dimension compile and query); the three cannot-answer tiers do not block; the measure gate over the same formula is unchanged (a `count` compiles, a `sum` keeps the stored-number remedy).
- `service-analytics` `preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts`: the shared `DATASET` declared three formula dimensions beside its stored ones, so every case in the file went red under the compile gate (19 red, measured). The formula dimensions moved to `FORMULA_DATASET` / `FORMULA_TEXT_DATASET`; the #28852 / #28977 cases are byte-unchanged and green, and the five #29167 / #29304 dataset-face cases now pin the compile refusal alike on every face (native, ObjectQL, preview), plus a case for a selection naming only the stored dimension. The query-time refusal itself stays pinned where no dataset compile stands in front of it: the engine door, `objectql-echo-non-date-bucket.test.ts` (the dry run) and `fallback-delegate-date-bucket-type.test.ts` (both untouched, green).
- `lint` `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.test.ts`, new top-level describe for the id: the dataset pin with exact message and hint plus a text control; a date-typed dimension bucketed over a formula of `returnType: 'date'`; a sweep over every `FieldType` agreeing with `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` (floors on both sides); the later position beside a stored dimension, never under the JSON-stored id; a dotted dimension judged on the joined object; a cube dimension over a formula column plus a stored control; the skips; the measure leg over a formula unchanged; through `runAuthoringRules` on all three commands. The #22161 one-line verdict / fix blocks now cover three ids.
- `lint` `runtime-gate.dataset-writes.test.ts`: a LIT case through the real dataset write door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`), refusal at `datasets.acme_invoice_metrics.dimensions[1].field`; `OBJECTS` gained one formula field, every other case unchanged and green.
- `dogfood` `analytics-formula-dimension-authoring.dogfood.test.ts` on the stock showcase (`showcase_project.budget_remaining`, a formula): `PUT /meta/dataset` answers 422 naming the id at `dimensions[1].field`, and `POST /analytics/dataset/query` with the inline dataset answers `400 DATASET_INVALID` naming the dimension and the remedy, for a selection with and without the formula dimension; controls save and serve the dataset without it. 5/5, plus the #29304 sibling 5/5.

<details><summary>Package runs</summary>

- At `b100c406` (the implementation commit, before the `origin/main` merge; the commits after it touch only the dogfood pin and the changeset, and the merge brought in no file of either package): `@objectstack/service-analytics` full suite 211 files / 5015 passed, 300 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0); `@objectstack/lint` full suite 195 files / 8236 passed (VERDICT 0); `typecheck` for both packages exit 0.
- Before the fix, the compile gate alone on the same suite: 1 file red, `preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts`, 19 cases (the shared fixture declared formula dimensions), which is what the fixture split answers.
- The dogfood pin with its #29304 sibling, 10/10 at the pre-tightening head `6c77bf99` (the merge commit); the pin alone 5/5 at `0dd6d595`, and both inside the full battery below.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores to HEAD and checks `git diff HEAD` is empty)</summary>

- Compile gate: deleted the `assertDimensionFieldStored(...)` call in `compileDataset` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `9bf5497fcd8b` → `6e7d8fe55a4a`). 10 red: the three new request / configuration / bucket door cases in `aggregate-nontemporal-measure-refusal.test.ts` and the seven `[#30773]` cases in `preview-date-bucket-type.test.ts`; 66 green, including the controls, the tiers and every measure pin. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Lint dataset leg: replaced `if (isVirtualSearchField(shape)) {` with a constant-false guard (blob `5f981455daa6` → `5e2fc683fa4f`). 7 red: six cases of the new describe and the runtime write-door LIT case; the cube case stayed green (its own leg). Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Lint cube leg: the same on `if (isVirtualSearchField(column.shape)) {` (blob → `0e485f1cf802`). 1 red, the cube case. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Both packages' tests import the subjects from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` rebuild was needed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The preview's own virtual arm is now pre-empted for a bare dataset dimension.** `queryDataset` compiles before the draft preview evaluates, and both read the same `sourceFieldMeta` hook, so the preview's call to `assertDatasetGroupTargetsStored` no longer sees a direct formula dimension (and its `declaredType` reads the base object only, so it never judged a dotted one). It is left in place as the date-bucket door's partner; carrier: none (noted, not filed).
- **Docs, skills and the upgrade guide** (the seat's rulings on contract review 6677341880): the `validating-metadata.mdx` paragraph is folded in here at `a97ed9f0` as a surface addendum; the skills formula row is follow-up #30824 (Tier H, the skills lane); an ADR-0087 semantic upgrade-guide entry mirroring `18.dataset-measure-aggregate-field-type-refused` is follow-up #30822 (the spec lane), to land before the release that ships this change.
- **The WIP commit `098b2b92` carries a `Claude-Session:` trailer naming the wrong session id** (the coordinator's); later commits carry this run's. The branch is a `claude/project-thread-*` branch, so it is not rewritten; the seat ruled it has no landing effect (squash merge).

All 64 ran and exited 0; `--ran` reports 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing+metadata-protocol-narrowed] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

After the docs commit `a97ed9f0` (`content/docs` only), the derivation grew to 89 families; the 25 new ones plus seven docs-reading families from the first pass were run at `a97ed9f0`, all exit 0, and `--ran` over the combined record reports 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The other families read no file the docs commit changed and keep their `0dd6d595` readings.
